items.q: It was a marvelous album called Jazz Band Tunes, and the way Dave Tuft plays drum on that

ctx.x: No, it was done in New York, about 1938 -- the end of '38, and maybe into '39. It was a marvelous album called Jazz Band Tunes, and the way Dave Tuft plays drum on that --
What did that come out on, was it Columbia?
